Module awtzero
Package awtzero.prefab

Class Button

java.lang.Object
awtzero.prefab.Button
public class Button extends Object
A simple Button prefab for AWTZero It consists of a rounded rectangle with a border with text on it with hover and click interactivity

The button is rudimentary and may not work perfectly in all cases. Use at your own risk. You are advised to make your own class for production use

Usage:

interact() is called continuously while the button is clicked

interactOnce() is called once per click These methods should be overridden to define button behavior

color1 is the inner color, color2 is the border color, and textColor is the text color

font defaults to Sans Serif, size 12. Can be changed with setFont(Font, int)

borderwidth can be changed with setBorderWidth(int)

border radius can be changed with setBorderRadius(int, int)
